name: Novice de la mesure
design: Young adult male, lanky young adult with angled shoulders, pale olive-grey broad cranial dome and flat crown ridge, thick scalp tendrils bundled to one back side. Examines a simple knotted measuring cord loosely stretched between hands; small leather pencil sleeve on belt. Straight attentive stance, no metallic gadget or armor.
